description.value: Snackshot is a Hong Kong-style dessert cafe offering creative takes on classic recipes, including tofu pudding and mahjong tile treats. The Richmond location at Sexsmith Road is one of three Lower Mainland outposts, with online ordering and an in-store catering and event-hosting service. A cyclist looking for a sweet stop in south Richmond will find a photo-friendly, sit-down dessert experience.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: rack at 39m; rack at 53m; stands at 56m; rack at 65m; rack at 78m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies this as a dessert cafe (branch: Richmond) with a discovered website URL. The cached website content successfully loaded and confirms three physical locations, with the Richmond branch at 2171-3779 Sexsmith Rd; the OSM branch tag aligns with this. The website includes 'Order Online' navigation links for both the Richmond and Kingsway locations, confirming takeout/online ordering. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record contains no address or phone number; address (2171-3779 Sexsmith Rd) and phone (+1 604-447-2171) were sourced from website for the Richmond branch only — OSM should be updated.
prefetch_status is 'front_fetch_failed' but cached HTML was available; contact_confirmed fields for phone and address cannot be fully cross-validated against OSM since OSM omits both.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating dessert cafe with confirmed Richmond address and online ordering; a legitimate refreshment stop for touring cyclists in south Richmond.
enrichment_extras.notes: Multi-location chain; OSM branch tag 'Richmond' matches the Sexsmith Rd location on the website. The Chinese name tag (name:yue: 糖百府) is present in OSM but not used on the English website.
